items.t: 'Outrageous' or Industry Standard? Trump Media Plans to Spend Up to $13 Million to Win Votes for TAE Fusion Merger: Report
items.sum: Trump Media could spend up to $13 million securing shareholder approval for its TAE merger, drawing criticism over proxy fees.

items.sum: Trump Media & Technology Group stock fell to record lows last week. Any rise in DJT would be an opportunity to exit the stock.

items.t: How Much Bitcoin Could Elon Musk Control if Tesla and SpaceX Merge?
items.sum: Tesla and SpaceX have both formed special committees to weigh a merger, and both sit on Bitcoin bought at very different times. Combine the stashes and a single board could hold a decision that rattles a market already under pressure.

items.t: Will Bitcoin Drop Below $50,000 Before It Recovers?
items.sum: Bitcoin just strung together its longest losing streak ever, ETF money keeps walking out, and a Federal Reserve decision looms. A handful of price levels will reveal whether the bleeding stops early or the real damage is still ahead.
